title: Associated primes of powers of closed neighborhood ideals and diameters of graphs
summary: Let $G$ be a simple connected graph and $t \ge 2$ an integer. We prove that if the maximal homogeneous ideal is an associated prime of the $t$th power of the closed neighborhood ideal of $G$, then the diameter of $G$ is at most $7t - 8$. We further show that this bound is sharp for all $t \ge 2$.
